(Perisytiharan Warisan Kebangsaan) (Objek Warisan) (No. 4) 2019.

Warisan Kebangsaan

2. Objek yang dinyatakan dalam Jadual yang telah diisytiharkan sebagai objek

warisan dalam Perisytiharan Objek Warisan 2018 [P.U. (B) 387/2018] yang disiarkan

dalam Warta pada 16 Julai 2018 dan disenaraikan dalam Daftar diisytiharkan sebagai

Warisan Kebangsaan.

NATIONAL HERITAGE ACT 2005

NATIONAL HERITAGE (DECLARATION OF NATIONAL HERITAGE)

(HERITAGE OBJECT) (NO. 4) ORDER 2019

IN exercise of the powers conferred by subsection 67(1) of the

National Heritage Act 2005 [Act 645], the Minister makes the following order:

Citation

1. This order may be cited as the National Heritage (Declaration of

National Heritage) (Heritage Object) (No. 4) Order 2019.

National Heritage

2. The objects specified in the Schedule that have been declared as heritage objects

in the Declaration of Heritage Object 2018 [P.U. (B) 387/2018] as published in the

Gazette on 16 July 2018 and listed in the Register are declared to be National Heritage.

SCHEDULE

(1)

Object

(2)

Owner of object

1. Warrior Mask and Wak Nujum Mask

(Awang Batil Performance)

Romli bin Mahamud

2. Batil (Awang Batil Performance) Romli bin Mahamud

4. Serunai (Awang Batil Performance) Romli bin Mahamud

bin Bonget

6. Versatile Seniman Agung Oscar National Archives of Malaysia
